correctness.rationale: The full nonlinear cooperative system is inward on the cube, irreducible and has a simple zero Perron mode at the stated criticality. A positive linear functional decreases by a nonnegative nonlinear remainder; LaSalle and strong positivity imply global extinction. Spectral-gap variation of constants gives alignment, and the exact arctan quadratic coefficient gives the componentwise inverse-time limit. The independent checker verifies rational witness values and 30 heterogeneous quadratic/eigenvector identities.
